steps.what: Identify the industrial-ecology principle and actual industrial material, energy and organizational constraints to which it might apply
Calculate explicit material or energy balance alternatives for the proposed eco-industrial practice in {SPREADSHEET}
Translate the theories of industrial ecology into eco-industrial practices by choosing feasible reuse, exchange or resource-efficiency arrangements and discussing actual constraints with operators
outputs: human practical design and unresolved constraints

steps.what: Write and check the actual practice proposal, responsibilities, assumptions and trial conditions in {DOCS}
inputs: human practical design and unresolved constraints

steps.what: Save the checked practice proposal in {DOCS}

tasks.design: Configure explicit material and energy balance calculations in {SPREADSHEET} over verified process evidence. The ecologist translates theory into feasible practice with operators and writes the proposal; no exchange contract or process change is automatically executed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated flow-balance arithmetic can slow practical comparison.
tasks.enabler_now: Native formulas can calculate explicit balances and sensitivities.
tasks.still_hard: Making an ecological principle work under actual technical and organizational constraints.
tasks.human_edge: Connecting theory to plant reality and partner incentives.

ambition.what: No new industrial exchange service is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less balance arithmetic, unchanged practice-design judgement.

evidence.claim: Explicit material and energy balances are calculable, but feasible eco-industrial arrangements require contextual human design.

assumptions: Boundary is translating theory into a practical proposal, including its actual record. Physical implementation, supplier agreements and operating changes are separate and receive no saving.

Existing process records supply actual flow ID, quantity, unit, period, composition and provenance; the ecologist verifies these in s1 and supplies explicit balance assumptions in s2. Missing or incompatible values require manual checking in retained work, not free new instrumentation.

Native formulas first. Only repeated arithmetic changes; operator consultation, feasibility choice and actual proposal writing remain full. Normal author check in s4 binds the exact saved proposal. Shares are provisional estimates.
unknowns: Availability of comparable actual process-flow records.
research_questions: Can reusable balances reveal alternatives without assuming a physically usable by-product?

already_counted.description: Practical interpretation, operator discussion and proposal writing remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain balance formulas and unit mappings.

approvals.approved_version: Exact practice proposal checked in s4; edits require recheck.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 40% less arithmetic on 25 share saves 10 points less 1 upkeep. Low is formulas already present or inadequate flow records.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define alternative energy investment scenarios, comparison boundaries and defensible economic and environmental assumptions
Develop the scenario cash-flow and environmental calculations in {SPREADSHEET} using explicit formulas and verified factors
Compare economic and environmental costs and benefits, test sensitivity and interpret trade-offs and uncertainty
Write and check the scenario comparison, assumptions and limits in {DOCS}
Save the checked scenario comparison in {DOCS}

tasks.design: Configure a native scenario workbook in {SPREADSHEET} with explicit cash-flow, energy and environmental-factor formulas. The ecologist chooses assumptions, interprets sensitivity and writes the final comparison; no investment recommendation or spending commitment is generated automatically.
tasks.previous_blocker: Alternative scenarios repeat the same calculations with different explicit inputs.
tasks.enabler_now: Native scenario tables can recalculate consistent formulas.
tasks.still_hard: Credible technology, price and environmental-boundary assumptions.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing which assumptions drive apparently attractive outcomes.

ambition.what: No additional investment authority is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less calculation assembly, unchanged scenario judgement.

evidence.claim: Explicit cash-flow and environmental-factor calculations can be parameterized, while assumption choice and trade-off interpretation remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is scenario development and its comparison record, not approval or execution of investment. No financial return or environmental benefit is invented as measured evidence.

Finance and technology records supply actual cost, unit, currency, price date and verified performance; environmental sources supply factor, unit, geography, year and method. The ecologist validates those inputs and supplies scenario assumptions in s1-s2. Missing factors or conflicting units are manually resolved within retained work.

Native formulas first. Only repeated calculation and scenario assembly change; source assessment, sensitivity interpretation and writing remain full. Normal final checking in s4 binds the completed comparison; ordinary save stays full.
unknowns: Existing workbook capability and reliability of scenario inputs.
research_questions: Can parameter tables expose uncertainty without suggesting forecasts are facts?

already_counted.description: Assumption choice, scenario interpretation and final comparison writing remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain scenario formulas and source-factor mappings.

approvals.approved_version: Exact scenario comparison checked in s4; edits require recheck.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 55% less calculation assembly on 40 share gives 22 points less 2 upkeep. Low is an existing scenario workbook or new assumptions needing manual reconstruction.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Determine the applicable environmental assessment scope, standards, regulations or laws and read the actual requirements
Carry out environmental assessments by checking actual site, process and measurement evidence against the applicable requirements
Complete and check the environmental assessment record in {DOCS}, linking actual evidence to requirements and preserving exceptions
Save the checked environmental assessment record in {DOCS}
Send the checked assessment record to its designated external requester through {EMAIL}

tasks.design: Configure native requirement and evidence-reference fields in the assessment record {DOCS}. The ecologist determines applicability, checks actual conditions and writes conclusions; the form reuses identifiers and structure without deciding compliance.
tasks.previous_blocker: Assessment records repeat requirement references and evidence identifiers.
tasks.enabler_now: Native structured fields can reuse verified identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: Applicability, conflicting evidence and defensible conclusions.
tasks.human_edge: Professional assessment and recognizing insufficient evidence.

ambition.what: No regulatory authority or automatic compliance ruling is added.

tasks.altitude: Less reference repetition, unchanged assessment responsibility.

evidence.claim: Structured assessment fields can reuse verified references, while applicability and environmental conclusions require human judgement.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual assessment, its record and routine delivery. Formal statutory filing or permit determination is not assumed from this general statement. Applicable national rules must be confirmed locally.

Requirement owners supply document ID, revision and clause; field and measurement records supply actual site, date, value, unit, method and evidence ID. The ecologist checks these in s1-s2 and writes actual findings in s3. Missing evidence is manually resolved; scheduled observations do not count as actual.

Native fields first. Only repeated reference entry and record structure change, not evidence capture or conclusions. Normal final check in s3 binds completed content and recipient; edits void both gates. Ordinary save and send retain full time.
unknowns: Actual assessment regime and current record structure.
research_questions: Can reference reuse preserve the correct requirement revision and unresolved exceptions?

already_counted.description: Requirements reading and actual environmental assessment remain counted.

approvals.approved_version: Exact assessment record checked in s3; edits require recheck.
Exact assessment and recipient checked in s3; edits require recheck.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 20% less reference-and-structure entry on 28 share saves 5.6 points less 1 upkeep. Low is native fields already populated; no assessment judgement saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Examine societal issues and technical-environment relationships.

steps.what: Read actual societal research and technical-system evidence relevant to the environmental question
Arrange source identifiers, populations, system boundaries and verified observations in the native research matrix {DOCS}
Examine societal issues and their relationship with technical systems and the environment, distinguishing reported associations from causal explanations
Write and check the research interpretation, limits and unresolved societal questions in {DOCS}
Save the checked societal research note in {DOCS}

tasks.design: Configure a native research matrix in {DOCS} to reuse actual citation fields and explicit comparison headings. The ecologist reads and interprets societal evidence and writes the findings; no model assigns social causation or infers opinions about individuals.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence matrices repeat source metadata and comparison structure.
tasks.enabler_now: Native tables can reuse citation records without making social judgements.
tasks.still_hard: Causal inference, representativeness and competing social explanations.
tasks.human_edge: Critical reading across technical and social disciplines.

ambition.what: No new population profiling or research coverage is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less matrix setup, unchanged societal interpretation.

evidence.claim: Native research tables can reuse source metadata, but societal interpretation and causal judgement remain human.

assumptions: Boundary includes research examination and its actual findings note. Stakeholder interviews or a new survey are not invented as already captured inputs or hidden labour savings.

Publishers supply actual title, identifier, year, population and source text; the ecologist supplies verified observation and system boundary during s1-s2. Missing metadata is checked manually, not generated from memory.

Native tables first. Savings concern source metadata and headings only, not reading, substantive observation capture, interpretation or note writing. Normal final checking in s4 binds the saved note. No external send is assumed.
unknowns: Actual repeated metadata entry and existing citation tools.
research_questions: Can the matrix retain differences in population and system boundary rather than flattening them?

already_counted.description: Source reading, societal interpretation and final note writing remain counted.

approvals.approved_version: Exact societal research note checked in s4; edits require recheck.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 30% less matrix assembly on 20 share gives 6 points less 0.75 upkeep. Low is existing citation reuse; no social interpretation saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Use explicit flow and scenario calculations while retaining scientific and societal judgement.
reach: Explain environmental boundaries and practical resource assumptions to engineers and investment analysts.
role.ambitious_version: An industrial ecologist whose practical proposals make technical and societal assumptions visible.
